notes.title: V1.1 Update: More intuitive level guidance and "perfect" achievements
notes.content:
Hello everyone! I am KUOKUO

During the period of game release, players reported that the building and operation instructions were difficult to understand. This update includes more intuitive (graphical) level guidance, as well as a new achievement!
